fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A bite that deals 18 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Hamstring Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 11 damage, leaves the target [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and makes it 30% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunting Cry
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 20% more damage and fights with 1 more power for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Courser at Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded courser runs at your heel, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every second. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
